request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me narrow that list to one stage. For example only the ones I have sent.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Let me verify the empty-filter case still renders correctly by confirming the `STAGES` constant and empty-state table logic — the edit preserved the existing `invoice-row-*` and other `data-testid` anchors untouched.

The change is complete and the test passes. Summary of the full-stack change I made for "narrow the invoices list to one stage":

- **Server (OfficeFloor)** — `AllInvoicesLogic` now accepts an optional `@HttpQueryParameter("status")`, mirroring the existing `q` search precedent in `ClientsLogic`, and forwards it to the service.
- **Data layer** — `InvoiceService.listAll(String status)` filters by `i.status = ?` when a stage is supplied (backed by the existing `V8__invoices_status_index`), returning all invoices when blank. No new migration was needed — the `status` column and its index already exist, and adding a gratuitous one would violate the "additive, whatever the request needs" rule.
- **Front-end** — `AllInvoicesPage` adds a `data-testid="invoice-status-filter"` `<select>` (All / DRAFT / SENT / PAID) whose selection re-fetches `/api/invoices?status=…`, narrowing the rendered `invoice-row-*` rows.

All pre-existing `data-testid` anchors are preserved, and the change stays local to the invoices feature. The Playwright spec passes (3 rows unfiltered → 2 rows after selecting SENT).
